description: Climate Change Projections for Water Storage Investment Program (WSIP) is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Water Commission. To aid applicants with quantification and monetization of benefits of proposed water storage projects per Chapter 8 of Proposition 1 (Water Code section 79750 et. seq.), the California Water Commission (Commission) developed a Technical Reference which was released in August 2016. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Water Commission. Its tags are california water commission, climate change, evapotranspiration, gcm, hydrologic. It offers 18 resource(s) in PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
